overview: Scoping review of engagement with epilepsy self-management apps, charting engagement and its association with adherence and seizure outcomes, reported with PRISMA-ScR.
population: Studies of adults with epilepsy using a self-management app with a seizure diary or medication reminder, 2012 onward, any design.
exposure: Level of engagement with the app as defined by each study.
procedures: The library runs searches in four databases and two app-evaluation repositories; two reviewers screen titles and abstracts; one charts and the other verifies. Charting records the engagement definition, follow-up, adherence and seizure outcomes by engagement level.

outcomes.name: Adherence and seizure outcomes by engagement level
outcomes.measure: Charted adherence and seizure frequency results reported for engaged and disengaged users

outcomes.name: Engagement definitions
outcomes.measure: Charted definition and measure of engagement

outcomes.name: Screening agreement
outcomes.measure: Kappa between reviewers on a 20 percent sample

feasibility: Six hours a week of screening across two reviewers from October to June.
biasMitigation: Charting verified by a second reviewer

biasFlags.label: Outcome reporting bias
biasFlags.note: Studies may report outcomes only for engaged users.

flags: Primary charted outcome is an effect-style outcome

summary: Scoping review protocol built around the PICO question on engagement and outcomes.
